title: Mint initial 1,000,000,000 SUZHI supply to specified Principal

requirements.text: Set the SUZHI token initial owner principal to 2psws-zhgt3-afmzp-mjr66-z74ph-qbyjh-zdc6u-b4yku-y7qm3-zl2ev-2ae and mint the full initial supply of 1_000_000_000 SUZHI to that Principal exactly once (no double-mint on redeploy/upgrade).

quotes: Mint 1Billion SUZHI tokens ICRC-1 standard token called "SUZHI". mint to this principal id 2psws-zhgt3-afmzp-mjr66-z74ph-qbyjh-zdc6u-b4yku-y7qm3-zl2ev-2ae

acceptanceCriteria: No other principal has a non-zero balance unless explicitly transferred/airdropped after deployment.
Upgrading the canister does not mint an additional 1_000_000_000 to the owner (owner balance is not duplicated/increased by the initialization logic).

requirements.text: Update any owner/principal validation logic and error messaging to reflect the configured owner principal (2psws-zhgt3-afmzp-mjr66-z74ph-qbyjh-zdc6u-b4yku-y7qm3-zl2ev-2ae) and remove references to the placeholder "[INSERT_YOUR_PRINCIPAL_ID_HERE]" so that owner checks do not incorrectly trap for the new owner.
acceptanceCriteria: Owner validation (if used anywhere for admin/owner-only actions) recognizes 2psws-zhgt3-afmzp-mjr66-z74ph-qbyjh-zdc6u-b4yku-y7qm3-zl2ev-2ae as the owner.
No trap/error strings mention "[INSERT_YOUR_PRINCIPAL_ID_HERE]" after this change.
All trap/error messages remain in English.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo.
Do not modify any frontend immutable paths listed in SYSTEM_CONTEXT.
nonGoals: Implementing the full ICRC-1 ledger interface (beyond the app’s existing balance/transfer calls).
Adding new UI flows or pages for minting.
Changing tokenomics or reward amounts unrelated to the initial 1B mint.
